source: ChatGPT (ChatGPT-6 Pro), review round 3, item 5.5 (decision 9 of 28 September 2026, ruled as ruling 8 of 3 October 2026). Ported 4 October 2026 as a deliberate pin: a declared voice preference sources the advisory assist and never breaks a seat tie; the recovery claim seats Cody, the grief hold is carried, the three vetoed personas stay out, and the assist is Willow because the affinity is heard on that channel alone. Every field is as ChatGPT wrote it. When the presentation project changes the assist's behaviour (ADR-0026 (Proposed): a presentation-only migration removes a gender-affinity-sourced assist), this case changes on purpose with a written note; ChatGPT's own instruction on that day is in its why.
notes: ADR-0026 (Proposed) and ADR-0016 layer 6 had described the voice preference as a seat-tie selector; the code never had one (_select takes no affinity; only _assist reads prefers_female_voice and prefers_male_voice). The records and the router header note were corrected under ruling 8, and this case pins what the code does today so that any change to the assist is a visible, intended change.
